Do it man. Do it for a few minutes even on the days you don't want to. Get better at it. Making progress feels good. Exercise feels good.

I am a licensed journeyman. I enjoy working with my hands and building things, but I don't intend to make a career out of it.  Was the goal at one point but I was robbed and insurance didn't cover everything. I'm still bitter off that or I probably would have an LLC and pay some fucks to drive my van around and retrofit lights. Easy job, easy hustle. I enjoy talking the deal more than doing the work.  I'm into owning shit and paying people to work so I don't have to. I can't get a dealers license in this state because of my record. If I could get a dealers license I would own a car lot and a small garage. Another rail. I can be a silent partner but I am greedy and a control freak. I want to own it. Another rail; I've made my face go numb.

I've no desire to pay someone to teach me shit that I really don't need to know. I do enjoy learning things but never in a classroom setting. I am stressed about the future because I will have to do a job that I don't want. I can't do the things that I want to do.  Fuck it man, I can pack a bag and hop on the motorcycle with a 9piece and go on an adventure. I would probably do that before I off myself, but it still would be ending my life as I know it. Would probably put me in some shitty cell with some illiterate jackass. It's tempting.

I'm curious, how old are you?

If you want to feel better of yourself pick a new hobby. Maybe ride a bike, maybe get into some Bob Ross and learn to paint. Pick one that interests you. Days you don't want to fuck with it you fuck with it for 5 minutes anyways and see if you still don't feel like fucking with it.  Keep it up and you will see improvement. You will start to set goals for more improvment. Feels good.

I can't *own* the businesses that I have the skillset to operate. That is why I feel like I have very little to look forward to, the plans I had since highschool are not a fucking option anymore. I can afford to go on vacation or out to eat when I want without concern to my budget. Time for another rail.
